extraction.method: Chrome (CDP) download of https://arena.ai/leaderboard/agent on 2026-10-20 (curl now gets a Cloudflare challenge); ranking entries (avgScore) and costStats parsed from the RSC payload.
extraction.scoreRule: Net Improvement % = avgScore.value × 100, 2 dp as displayed (page row: Claude Fable 5.1 (Max) 14.55% ±1.92%); median cost/task = costStats P50, 14-day window.
mappingNotes: Qwen3.8 Max (contenders/paisley-n9x0) → qwen3.8-max by exact display name; the page does not say whether it is the 0803 or 0902 build.
Not mapped: Qwen3.8 Flash Next, Muse Spark 1.1, GPT 5.4 (High), Gemini 4 Argon, Solar Pro 4.

round3 additions (exact model, adopted served models only): contenders/claude-opus-5.5-max-vertex-agent→claude-opus-5.5, contenders/gpt-6.1-sol-max-agent→gpt-6.1-sol, contenders/claude-sonnet-5-5-max-agent→claude-sonnet-5.5, contenders/mimo-v2-6-pro-public-agent→mimo-v2.6-pro, contenders/mimo-v2-6-flash-agent→mimo-v2.6-flash, contenders/claude-haiku-5.5-high-vertex-agent→claude-haiku-5.5, contenders/gpt-6-luna-medium→gpt-6-luna, contenders/gpt-6-luna-low-agent→gpt-6-luna, contenders/step-5-preview-agent→step-5-preview, contenders/may26-chatbot4-public-agent→nemotron-3-ultra, contenders/deepseek-v4.1-flash-max-20261017→deepseek-v4.1-flash.
Not mapped: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, Mistral Large 4, Muse Wonder, Beam 1.0.
